series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

ndc_assessment.summary: Please note that the INDC was submitted only in French. WRI did its best to translate the INDC language. If any errors are identified, please contact us at ClimateWatch@WRI.org "Réduction inconditionnelle de 2,5% (BAU 2020) et 3,5% (2030). Réduction conditionnelle de 25% (BAU 2020) et 34,6%.(2030, soit une réduction de 33.400 GgCO 2 Eq)." Unconditional reduction of 2.5% (BAU 2020) and of 3.5% (2030). Conditional Reduction of 25% (BAU 2020) and 34.6% (2030, or a reduction of 33,400 GgCO 2 Eq).

ndc_assessment.$note: Third-party assessment of the first (I)NDC round. It is not merged into ndc.*, is not used by derive(), and does not appear on the dial as a target.

evidence.sentence: The emissions reduction of the two priority sectors, AFOLU, and energy is estimated at 33,400 GgCO2e, 34,7% compared to BaU in 2030.

According to figure 3 below: • For 2030, the INDC with unconditional financing permits a GHG emissions reduction of 3.5% compared to BAU, while the INDC with conditional financing permits an emissions reduction of 34.6 % compared to BaU.

• For 2020, the INDC under unconditional financing permits a 2.5% reduction of GHG emissions compared to BaU (2030), while the INDC with conditional financing permits an emissions reduction of 25% compared to BaU.

DS-05's rows are non-CO₂ gases only and are not comparable with the others; that is also why DS-05 is absent from series.observed, where a shorter curve would read as a disagreement rather than a difference of scope. by_source carries each source whole.

verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is First NDC (Updated submission), filed 2021-12-13. 49 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (3). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-35 52.1 MtCO₂e, DS-02 48.7 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 4 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 35.4 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 2.5% (unconditional) to 25%(conditional) reduction by 2020 and of 3.5% (unconditional) to 34.6%(conditional) reduction by 2030 in GHG emissions compared to the BAU scenario It was classed both. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.25°C under SSP1-2.6 to +5.18°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
